title: MCP Server
description: Manage personal access to read-only business tools.

hub.title: Agent collaboration
hub.subtitle: Switch between remote business MCP credentials, the page MCP connection and distributable WebSkills on one page.

name: Token name
rotateHelp: Rotating invalidates the old token immediately. The new token is shown once.
revokeHelp: Revoking invalidates this token immediately and cannot be undone.
secretOnce: Save this token now. It will only be shown once.
import: Import this configuration and provide your token through the named environment variable. Configuration alone does not confirm a connection.
workbuddyHelp: Import the configuration and enter your token locally. Replace the placeholder before use; do not share your credential.

validation.name: Enter a token name of 1–100 characters.
validation.days: Validity must be between 1 and 90 days.
validation.department: Choose a department you may issue tokens for.
validation.tools: Select at least one allowed tool.

failure.forbidden: The password is wrong, or this department may not issue tokens.
failure.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again and retry.
failure.invalid: The server rejected this submission. Check the validity and the selected tools.
failure.unavailable: The service is unavailable. Confirm the API is running and migrations are applied.
failure.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait and try again.
failure.internal: The server failed to process the request. Check the API logs.
failure.conflict: That token conflicts with the current state. Refresh and retry.

catalogUnavailable: The tool catalog cannot be loaded; no token can be issued without it.
catalogBlocked: The tool catalog is not loaded yet, so the allowed tools are unknown. Try again shortly.
helperHelp: Run the helper locally to install. Enter its pairing key and your Token. Diagnosis requires context_get. Existing configuration is backed up; installation alone does not prove the target client is connected.
installTarget: Install {{client}} for {{url}} on the helper computer. Configuration and credentials will be saved locally.

helperStatus.installed: Installed. Restart the target client and verify it.
helperStatus.connected: Remote initialization, discovery and tool call succeeded.
helperStatus.failed: Connection or installation failed. Check the helper, Token and service. Installation may have updated local files; restore the .backup files if needed.

tokenLimits: Up to 20 active tokens. Valid for 30 days by default, at most 90 days. All current tools are read-only.
emergencyHelp: With the dedicated management permission, revoke a specified token in this workspace. Ask the owner for its Token ID.
